protocol.training: 2021-2023 listings; 2024 validation; final 2021-2024; test 2025-2026. Disjoint issuer IDs and later-label maturity purges.
protocol.forecast: After completed session, predict next observed close / current close - 1.
protocol.execution: Signal at 18:00 IST, execute at next open. Learned trading target: following open / next open - 1. Carry overnight; change positions only on signals. Liquidate at last common test close.
protocol.news: Verified issuer headlines only, trailing seven days, previous calendar dates only. Exchange events require source publication timestamp <= decision. Current fetch time never supplies a historical clock.
protocol.costs: 35bps per round trip (17.5bps each buy and sell), stress tested at 15/60bps. No shorting or leverage.
protocol.selection: Maximum 2024 mean net issuer return among candidates with >=10 validation buys. No choice based on later results.
caveats: Previously inspected later years are retrospective development tests, not blind proof.
Historical EOD bars assumed available by 18:00; source publication clocks are not exhaustive.
Windows begin at session 21; early listing-day forecasts are not evaluated.
RSS archive results are incomplete; empty results do not establish absence of news.
Equal initial capital per issuer, varying windows, no annualisation; circuit fills, slippage beyond assumed costs and shared calendar dependence need prospective verification.
